title: A Synthetic Chemoinformatics Testbed for Evaluating Model Interpretability and Green Catalyst Prioritization
description: This software and data release accompanies a preliminary computational technical note on a synthetic chemoinformatics benchmark for catalytic alcohol oxidation. It includes a 5,000-row synthetic reference dataset, an archived seed-level metrics log for seeds 42–61, a consolidated reproduction script, the substrate library, dependencies, and notebook traceability documentation. The synthetic targets are generated from a specified heuristic data-generating process and are not experimental measurements or validated predictions of real catalyst performance. The archived 20-seed metrics reproduce the reported manuscript summary statistics to three decimal places. However, the saved final notebook execution reused an existing metrics log rather than rerunning the complete cross-validation suite, and an independent clean rerun has not yet completed successfully. The results are therefore traceable and consistency-checked, not independently reproduced in a clean environment. TreeSHAP results are illustrative for one fitted Seed 42 model, and the Green Prioritization Index is an author-defined heuristic rather than a validated sustainability metric.
